Every graph part stays within the 1,048,576-byte answer bound and the part number within MAX_PART 1000, as a snapshot part is bounded; the paged answer is decoded by closed fields, and MCP tool results keep their size bound.
A graph part carries only what the graph answer crossing already carries: the same nodes and states, control values masked on every carrier, no NodeId and no attribute text.

The press verb may gain a Ctrl (and Meta/Alt) modifier: a new flag argument of a closed value set inside a ratified carrier, on the session socket call, the command line, MCP and the kept check — no new carrier crossed (closed-value field is no widening).

Any new argument enters the driver argument kinds of the closed driver verb schema and passes the one validation path for every carrier; a bad or out-of-range value is refused by the closed refusal cause set (malformed), with no echo of caller input and no panic on call input.
The escher-session flags register gains the modifier flag beside --shift and the part flag on graph, read by the closed argv reader; the command line echoes nothing typed.

The driver's self-description and the MCP tool listing stay fixed program text, updated for the new arguments and for the press limit the help states; MCP tool arguments keep their closed value kinds.

A kept check records the new argument shapes; the recorded check file is read strictly as untrusted on replay, replay runs each step through the session, and the kept check keeps each graph answer whole as it holds the graph answer today.

A Ctrl press builds a non-adjacent multiple select set: multiple select keys and clicks, where the chosen set leaves, every select choice through one write path, and select keys passing a closed match.
Modifier key events the driver dispatches are untrusted-source engine dispatches: isTrusted by dispatch source, and the press keeps the engine's key and activation rules.
The reached-handler record may read a stopPropagation of a bubbling dispatch: it stays without log or NodeId, deduplicated and kept past element removal, recorded only where a signal registry stands.
The coverage answer line of the escher-session coverage role (checks, held, unexercised) keeps carrying no user data when the stop is read; coverage still refuses an unusable check as malformed.
The committed capability statement's stated limits (handler_coverage, escher-session coverage, press, graph) change with each fix or keep, and its pin re-asserts them.
The driver command span stays one content-free span per call, its verb field the only verb mark: no part number, modifier or answer content reaches a log, and driver outcomes are never logged.
Each debt the founder keeps stays a residual with his reason; a fix is proven on the stand through every ratified carrier of the driver.
